name: Arcader
review:
A 15-line retro sci-fi oddity about alien monoliths and a sentient machine handing out cash and experiences. It's one of Thunderkick's quirkier early games, and the humour is a big part of the appeal.

Low volatility, 1,600x cap, 96.1% RTP. Not one for big hits, but a relaxed play if you like the studio's offbeat style.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
